definitions.gloss: repeating a year, being held back
definitions.explanation: Having to repeat the same grade or year in school due to failing to meet academic requirements or attendance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{単位|たんい}→単位：03412_tani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りなくて→足りる：01209_tariru⟧{留年|りゅうねん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I had to repeat a year because I didn't have enough credits.

examples.japanese: {留年|りゅうねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦ために→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{必死|ひっし}→必死：03705_hisshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I studied desperately to avoid repeating a year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧⟦{日数|にっすう}→日数：12953_nissuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りなくて→足りる：01209_tariru⟧、{留年|りゅうねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まって→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: I didn't have enough attendance days, so it was decided that I would repeat the year.

notes:
{留年|りゅうねん} means repeating a school year due to insufficient credits or attendance. It can happen at any educational level but is most commonly discussed in the context of university.

FORMS:
{留|りゅう} (stay, remain) + ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (year).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {留年|りゅうねん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to repeat a year
- {留年|りゅうねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧: to be confirmed that one will repeat
- {留年|りゅうねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: to avoid repeating a year
- {留年|りゅうねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まって→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦しまった→仕舞う：03064_shimau⟧: it was decided I'd be held back

COMMON CAUSES:
- ⟦{単位|たんい}→単位：03412_tani⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: not enough credits
- ⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧⟦{日数|にっすう}→日数：12953_nissuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りない→足りる：01209_tariru⟧: not enough attendance days

- ⟦{落第|らくだい}→落第：07793_rakudai⟧: failing, flunking
